en_how: A night stadium of additively blended wedge-gradient searchlight beams sweeping with t, stands made of dot-matrix lights switched by a hash and t, and a corner of striped pitch; at 1.4 s a navy data card with jersey stripes slides in, numbers roll and orange-versus-steel-blue comparison bars fill; at 3.6 s a goal flips the score bug to 2–1 and confetti falls on paths computed only from t.
